title: Claim guardrails: safe claims, do-not-claim, overclaim words
outcome: A checklist Aarav can run his draft against, separating claims we can defend from claims a jury will punish
acceptance: Three lists: safe claims (from RES-11 §5 and CALL-01 D1-D13, each with the decision or source that backs it), do-not-claim (SYNTHESIS §3 plus D2/D6/D7 wording limits), overclaim words with a safer alternative (first, novel, tamper-proof, compliant, guarantees, eliminates, prevents, real-time)
Our own numbers are listed only as definitions plus labelled targets (R=0, C=0, post-alert tainted effects=0), never as results (D13)
Each item is a phrase or rule, not a ready-to-paste abstract sentence; every do-not-claim item cites its reason (source or decision id)
summary: abstract/GUARDRAILS.md v2 (panel fixes applied). (1) 32 safe claims (P1-P6, F1-F13, W1-W6, L1-L7), each with source/decision id and wording condition; P2 now uses FACT-CARD #1/#2 wording only (roughly; METR, preliminary findings; July 2026, no day; agents in OpenAI's ExploitGym evaluation runs; about two days later; never internal/cyber). W4: Art 14(4)(e) stop 'in a safe state'; RBI FREE-AI quote only after checking the report's exact words (status S), else omit. Ground rule 2 + self-check 2 name abstract/FACT-CARD.md as the only source for outside numbers (SYNTHESIS §2 dropped). Own numbers only as definitions + labelled targets (D13). (2) 33 do-not-claim items X1-X33: X10 = leave MAST out; X11 adds 'Mohammadi et al.' and the 29 May 2026 Atomix date; X12 adds frontier gating and its alternative is concept + arXiv ID only, no number; new X31 Cordon 45/45 vs 14/45, X32 DeltaBox ms, X33 any GoEx number. (3) 19 overclaim words with concepts; 'cancelled (payment)' row reworded: containment never cancels (release = un-hold + restore epoch, CALL-01), a held item is cancelled only by an approved cancel_outbox recovery-plan step after the dry-run diff (maya.md C5), so the TERMS term stays usable. (4) 12-point self-check. 'Changes v2' note at the bottom.
review:
[panel · changes] CHANGES (4 must-fix, all small). Structure, D13 handling (§1.5 definitions + labelled targets only), RES-11 §5 must-not coverage (X1-X5, X8, X14) and the no-pasteable-prose rule all pass. Spot-checks PASS: P4 (fact 8; RES-11 §4 #2-#3), P5 (RES-11 §4 #6), P6 (facts 4/6), F8 (D7, C4), F12 (D6, C1), L5 (C2), W1 (principle 10). Spot-checks FAIL: P2 and W4.
(1) P2 tells Aarav to write 'internal OpenAI cyber evaluation'. FACT-CARD #1 (A~ note) bans exactly that: METR says neither 'internal' nor 'cyber'. Replace the P2 condition with FACT-CARD #1/#2 wording: 'roughly', 'METR, preliminary findings', 'July 2026' (no day), 'agents in OpenAI's ExploitGym evaluation runs', 'about two days later'. Ground rule 2 and self-check 2 must name abstract/FACT-CARD.md as the only source. Drop 'SYNTHESIS §2': it differs from the card (fact 1 wording, fact 11 'all Development' vs 'not yet stable').
(2) The safer alternatives in X10 and X12 point to numbers that are not on the fact card. X10 offers MAST kappa 0.77, and X12 points to the 'RES-10 wording column', which carries Cordon 45/45 vs 14/45, DeltaBox ms and so on. Under D13 these cannot be printed, and FACT-CARD 'not safe to print' lists them. Change X10 to 'leave MAST out' and X12 to 'concept + arXiv ID only, no number (D13)'. Add explicit X rows for Cordon 45/45 vs 14/45, DeltaBox ms figures and any GoEx number.
(3) RES-10 DROP coverage is incomplete. DROP 5 also drops 'frontier gating improves success under speculation', the 'Mohammadi et al.' author attribution and the 29 May 2026 Atomix date. Add them to X11/X12.
(4) W4: the RBI FREE-AI quote is status S on the fact card ('open the report and check the exact words before printing'). Add that as its condition, else omit it. Use the card's Art 14(4)(e) wording: stop 'in a safe state'.
Zoya's open point: AGREE. CALL-01 'we hold, never cancel' is release semantics for containment (release = un-hold + restore epoch). cancel_outbox is a C5 RecoveryPlan step (maya.md C5; TERMS 'cancel (outbox item)'), so it runs only as an approved recovery-plan step after the dry-run diff. F11 and X29 are right. Fix the §3 row 'cancelled (payment)'. As written ('We hold, never cancel (C6)') it bans a locked term. Make it: containment never cancels; a held item is cancelled only by an approved recovery-plan step (cancel_outbox) after the dry-run diff. Cite CALL-01 release semantics + maya.md C5, not C6 (SEC-01 is rewording C6).
Nit: P1 is closest to a pasteable thesis sentence. Keep it as a note.
